name: vestige
description: Local-first Vestige memory for Codex CLI. Causal Backfill over MCP tools recall, smart_ingest, and backfill.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first agent memory with Causal Backfill
interface.longDescription: Launches vestige-mcp-server@2.7.1 locally via npx and exposes three MCP tools: recall, smart_ingest, and backfill. Memories stay on your machine. This wrapper is a distribution plugin for local and synthetic use, not a hosted production service.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we decided about this project's datastore.
